gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.allo: Smelts steel and advanced industrial alloys from dual inputs. Reach Lv.6 to unlock the Assembler.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.asse: Assembles circuits and reinforced frames needed for Tier 4-5 machinery. Keep it running steadily!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.craf: Auto-crafts saved recipes with smart pipe I/O. Leveling raises its Motor cap up to 64!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.crus: Your first 2x ore doubler! Power with Thermal/Hydro, crush raw ore into Dust [I], then smelt. Lv.3 unlocks Electrolyzer!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.elec: Smelts at 2x vanilla furnace speed. Can smelt any ore-line stage straight into ingots.
Refines Dust [I] to Pure Ore [II] (4x) and Stage 6 (64x) concentrate. Lv.6 unlocks Precision Crusher!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.fast: Batch-crushes stacks at high throughput. Ideal for clearing bottlenecks in quarry & 64x ore lines.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.larg: Ore-filtered mega quarry! Leveling raises Motor and Battery slot limits up to 64 each.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.matt: Amplifies cultivated matter with high FE input. Pair with Nuclear power and Energy Buffer Mk.III.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.meta: Presses ingots into plates for machine frames and runs Stage 4 (16x) ore washing. Reach Lv.3-5 early.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.ore_: Pinnacle machine! Drives Stages 7-15 up to 32,768x ore yield. Unlocking all 17 breaks the cap to Lv.1000!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.phas: Synthesizes phase-shifted materials for Tier 5 endgame. Lv.20 unlocks Quantum Compressor, Lv.25 Ore Synthesizer!
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.prec: Processes Pure Ore [II] into Exposed Ore [III] (8x), bridging into the full 64x ore-doubling chain.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.quan: Compresses materials into quantum-grade components. Raise to Lv.25 for the Ore Synthesizer.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.quar: Automated area miner! Leveling expands both Motor and Battery upgrade caps from 1 to 64.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.reco: Analyzes samples to reconstruct rare mythic ores. Required prerequisite for the Matter Amplifier.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.guide.seed: Cultivates mineral seeds for sustainable resource generation. Lv.12 unlocks the Matter Amplifier.
gui.industrialcore.skill_tree.mystery_gu: Unlock prerequisite machines to reveal details.
